recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "From A Tick Bite To A Light Protocol", "body": "Jackie Jolie tells Chance Garton how a tick bite left her with chronic fatigue, crashed hormones and brain fog so severe she could not recall the vocabulary of her own job doing bodywork on horses. Her doctor confirmed Lyme and prescribed three months of antibiotics. She asked what happens if the Lyme is still there afterward, was told they simply prescribe three more months, and decided that meant the drugs do not work. She never filled the prescription, used Dr. Steven Buhner's herbal protocol instead, and worked with a naturopath on her gut and mitochondria."}, {"title": "Why She Bet Everything On Free Sunlight", "body": "Her trainer Jim Laird pointed her to Dr. Jack Kruse, the New Orleans neurosurgeon who has spent nearly two decades teaching quantum health. Jackie admits much of the physics goes over her head, but the practical promise landed. She had been spending roughly five thousand dollars a year on supplements, gut tests and blood work without ever feeling optimal. Being cheap, as she puts it, was one of her biggest drivers. Sunlight costs nothing, so she got off the supplement train, gave the light train ninety days, and two and a half years later has not stopped."}, {"title": "What The Sun Actually Does Across A Day", "body": "Jackie walks through the full spectrum using the grade school rainbow, red through violet. Sunrise and sunset deliver red, orange and yellow, the same healing wavelengths sold back to us in infrared saunas and anti aging lasers. Once the sun climbs past thirty degrees the blue, green, UVA and UVB arrive, building vitamin D, sexual hormones, and naturally lowering blood pressure and cholesterol. Morning red light builds what she calls a solar callus, a natural SPF. Modern people skip that entirely, burn once a year at the beach, spray on sunscreen, and then blame the sun for cancer."}, {"title": "Circadian Clocks And The Case Against Blue Light", "body": "Every system in the body runs on a clock, and the master clock sits behind the hypothalamus in the suprachiasmatic nucleus, which takes its signal only through the retina. Sunrise light with no sunglasses and no contacts raises cortisol, blood sugar and hormones on schedule. Fire, candles and incandescent bulbs emit no blue, so they never disturbed our ancestors. LEDs, fluorescents and phone screens emit blue alone, telling the body it is noon at eight at night. Jackie says that is why athletes who eat well and train hard still end up tired and pre diabetic."}, {"title": "The Sun As Son Of God And The Spiritual Return", "body": "Raised in a strict Christian home she ran from, Jackie now says the sun is literally the son of God, and that the Bible reads as astrology told as story. Chance Garton runs with it, describing the sun as a fractal creator one step down from source, and connecting Christos, Krishna and the black sun to the light carried inside the body. Jackie credits a Tulum beach trip with downloading her idea for an animal light therapy device. Chance ties her gut and hormone results to Qigong organ clocks he learned from John Monroe, and to grounding and cold exposure."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Jackie Jolie joins InnerVerse to discuss her journey from sickness to health, using the light of the sun to reprogram her body for optimal wellness. We'll discover her backstory with lyme disease and the medical establishment's failure to fix it, how modern artificial light is effecting us, and the strategies you can employ to enhance your alignment to nature's circadian biorhythms and experience enlightening rejuvenation.
